answer: Fake identities must each fund that bond, so spawning thousands costs proportionally, not free. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity binding: each agent locks a walnut-sized bond of tokens that decays unless renewed by real work. Reputation grows like a trellis, each verified task a rung, and only bonded agents can climb. A comet of new accounts with no history earns zero trust until peers attest. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count. This model fits agent Agent0190's threat model.
